english.note: Use 存貨 as the all-purpose noun for goods kept ready for sale.
Use this for goods or stock held by a business, rather than for the place or a reserve.

examples.english: This stock hasn’t all been sold yet.
examples.jyutping: ni1 pai1 cyun4 fo3 zung6 mei6 cing1 dak1 saai3

examples.english: This store is almost sold out.
examples.jyutping: ni1 pai1 cyun4 fo3 zau6 faai3 maai6 saai3 laa3
